**What You Will Do**
 The Software Developer (Salesforce) develops, enhances, and supports Salesforce solutions that enable critical business processes and technology initiatives. This role partners with business and technical teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions, build integrations across systems, and deliver secure, high\-quality applications that improve operational efficiency, data flow, and user experience.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Salesforce Development \& Solution Delivery
+ Design, develop, test, and support Salesforce solutions that address business requirements and improve operational processes.
+ Translate functional and technical requirements into application components, workflows, and system enhancements on the Salesforce platform.
+ Build and maintain Apex, Flow, integrations, and platform components to support business process automation and system functionality.
+ Configure and enhance Salesforce features, custom objects, validations, and automation to support evolving business needs.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, production issues, and platform\-related problems in a timely manner.
+ Follow established development standards, testing practices, and documentation requirements to support solution quality and maintainability.

* System Integration \& API Support
+ Develop, maintain, and support integrations between Salesforce and internal or external systems using APIs, middleware, and platform tools.
+ Build and enhance interface components that enable reliable data exchange across systems and support business workflows.
+ Implement asynchronous processing, event\-driven capabilities, and integration logic to support performance and scalability.
+ Participate in integration testing, issue resolution, and monitoring activities to help ensure accurate and reliable data flow.
+ Work with integration, middleware, and data teams to support interface requirements, mappings, and technical specifications.
+ Apply security and control requirements in the handling of system interfaces and sensitive data.

* Data Management, Platform Support \& Reliability
+ Support the design and maintenance of data structures, validation rules, and data quality controls within Salesforce.
+ Develop and enhance processes that improve data accuracy, consistency, and usability across the platform.
+ Assist with data conversion, migration, and bulk processing activities related to enhancements or system changes.
+ Identify and resolve data\-related issues, including validation failures, duplicate records, and integration exceptions.
+ Support platform reliability through monitoring, defect remediation, and performance improvement efforts.
+ Maintain technical documentation for configurations, integrations, and support procedures.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Technical Analysis
+ Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and support solution delivery.
+ Participate in technical design discussions and provide input on scalable, supportable approaches for platform enhancements.
+ Work with architecture, integration, and data teams to ensure solutions align with established standards and technical requirements.
+ Communicate technical issues, dependencies, and implementation considerations clearly to project teams and stakeholders.
+ Support planning, estimation, testing, and release activities for projects, enhancements, and production changes.

* Continuous Improvement, Standards \& Quality
+ Follow established development standards, deployment processes, and platform governance practices in the delivery of assigned work.
+ Contribute to code quality, test coverage, and maintainability through peer reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices.
+ Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance system usability and efficiency.
+ Support deployment, post\-release validation, and issue resolution activities for platform changes.
+ Stay current on Salesforce platform capabilities, development tools, and related technologies to support ongoing skill development and solution improvement.


**What You Will Bring To The Role**
* Minimum 5\-7 years of Salesforce development experience, including implementation, enhancement, and support work in enterprise environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Apex development, declarative automation, and Salesforce platform customization.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems, APIs, middleware platforms, and third party services.
* Experience supporting scalable workflows, transaction processing, and multi\-system integrations.
* Experience supporting business\-critical applications, workflow solutions, or transaction processing systems in enterprise environments.

 Preferred experience may vary by assigned team or product area and may include experience with one or more of the following:

* Strong knowledge of Salesforce application development, solution delivery, and integration concepts.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and support effective technical solutions.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

**Job Profile**
**Position Overview**
 At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Data Scientist within PNC's Data, Modeling \& Analytics Marketing \& Customer Analytics organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Tysons Corner, VA or Wilmington, DE.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Data Scientist \- Marketing Valuations will support profitable growth by developing, enhancing, and applying valuation analytics and statistical models to inform marketing decisions.
   

  

 This role focuses on analyzing customer, offer, and channel economics to generate insights that help guide prioritization, optimization, and investment decisions across marketing initiatives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a solid foundation in statistical modeling and data analysis.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Valuation Modeling \& Forecasting: Assist in the development and maintenance of valuation and forecasting models, including Net Present Value (NPV), Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Offer Economics models to support marketing budget and investment decisions.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to measure performance, estimate incremental impact, and evaluate business trade\-offs.
* Business Analysis \& Insights: Analyze customer and marketing data to identify trends, evaluate opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Analytical Execution: Support the end\-to\-end analytical process, including data preparation, exploratory analysis, model development, validation, and performance monitoring.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, finance, and data teams to understand business needs, communicate analytical findings, and support implementation of valuation\-based recommendations.


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* Experience in data science, advanced analytics, quantitative modeling, marketing analytics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with marketing valuation concepts, including customer lifetime value, offer economics, marketing measurement, or related analytical methodologies.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL. Exposure to cloud platforms and big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop is a plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality work.

* Runs analytical experiments in a methodical manner to find opportunities for product and process optimization. Assists in the presentation of business insights to management using visualization technologies and data storytelling.
* May partner with Data Architects, Data Analysts, Data Engineers and Visualization Experts to develop data\-driven solutions for the business.
